bullets.text: Chennai police humiliated economist A Kalaiyarasan by whisking him away from his Adyar home over a fake social media post, and the office should monitor police overreach.
Economist A Kalaiyarasan suffered an early-morning ordeal in Chennai when officers took him in his nightclothes, prompting the office to watch for further civil liberties complaints.
Ponneri municipality refused to collect garbage from a local panchayat in Thiruvallur, leaving the panchayat without a dumping site, and the district team should help resolve the waste dispute.
Traders in Gummidipoondi detained a Highways Department vehicle after footpath sales items were removed, and the office should watch for local protests and trader grievances.
L&T subsidiary Vyoma.AI held a groundbreaking ceremony for its 52-megawatt data centre project in Chennai, and the portfolio team should support regional AI infrastructure growth.
Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that the Digital Personal Data Protection Act will not impact press freedom, and the department should review digital compliance guidelines.
AMMK general secretary TTV Dhinakaran criticized the government over Thirmumazhisai electric crematorium issues requiring generators, and the office should track opposition statements.
TTV Dhinakaran condemned the state over crematorium electricity failures in Thirumazhisai, and the team should watch for administrative follow-ups on public utilities.
